Subject: POC workback + eval criteria to pick hosting lane (hosted / dedicated / private)

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — appreciate the clarity on volumes and the compliance constraints. As promised, attaching a redline of the MAP and a minimal scoring matrix to speed selection between Hosted / Dedicated / Private for your PoC. High-level ask: can we lock the hosting decision by the end of next week so engineering can provision the appropriate environment?

Key items I want to surface before we all sign the MAP:
- Data residency: you mentioned that PHI must remain in US regions and that some telemetry can be aggregated. If the CISO requires on-prem, we'll mark Private as a hard requirement.
- SLA needs: 99.9% for inference endpoints in production vs 99.5% acceptable for PoC.
- Throughput & bursts: PoC expected to peak at ~250 reqs/min with occasional 2x bursts; Dedicated helps here.
- Integration scope: SSO + SCIM for SAML at cutover; hosted supports SAML; private will need network setup.

Next steps I propose:
1) We (Redwood) finalize the weighting matrix (attached) and send to Lena for a quick sign-off on risk tolerances by Thu 12/16.
2) Careline picks preferred lane (hosted/dedicated/private) and marks any non-negotiables in the MAP by Mon 12/20.
3) If Dedicated or Private chosen, Marissa will schedule a capacity call and we scope networking. If Hosted chosen, we provide a single-account fast-path and a preflight checklist.

I've attached: Careline_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP draft), hosting-eval-weighting-matrix.csv, SOC2-summary.pdf.

Can you confirm Lena is available for a 30-min risk alignment on Thu? I can send a calendar hold.

Thanks,

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Connor / team —

Quick recap from the call:
- SOC2 summary is helpful but not sufficient for production. For the PoC we can accept the summary provided we keep data segmentation and telemetry limits in place and we don't ingest raw PHI into third-party analytics during the PoC.
- Risk threshold: for PoC we can tolerate Hosted as long as data residency is enforced to US-only and a contractual data-use clause is included. If Redwood cannot guarantee US-only tenancy for the PoC controls, we will need Dedicated or Private.
- Network: if we go Dedicated/Private we'll need an IP allowlist and VPN termination; please include a runbook estimate in the MAP.
- Procurement: they asked for a short clause allowing termination of the PoC within 30 days with limited liability — Procurement to send exact wording.

Action items we agreed on call:
- Connor / Marissa: update the MAP with the runbook rows and the weighting matrix; circulate v4 by EOD Thu 12/16.
- Careline procurement: send termination clause by Fri 12/17.
- Redwood engineering: provide an estimate of time-to-provision for Dedicated vs Private by Mon 12/20.
